text:
Alex: Heads-up: we need to lock down rerank billing semantics for hedged routing. PM wants clarity for console billing cards + quotas before we roll to customers. Quick take?

Priya: TL;DR: bill for actual work done on the GPU. That avoids surprise invoices when we short-circuit. But we need to expose requested fanout too for visibility.

Chen: Agree with billing on actual GPU evals. Two real problems: hedged requests can duplicate evaluate the same candidate across replicas, and dedupe across models (primary vs fallback) is tricky.

Alex: If we dedupe, we must explain it clearly in billing docs. Customers often correlate "requests" -> quota usage. If billed < requested, they might think credit not applied.

Priya: Proposal: default behavior = bill deduped actual evals (closest to ops costs). Console shows both fields: "requested_candidates" and "billed_candidates". Also show a tooltip: "we may dedupe duplicate evals during hedging; billed reflects work performed."

Chen: Implementation idea: use a per-request nonce and a short-lived in-memory shard-local bitset keyed by (nonce + candidate_id). When a replica sees candidate, it sets bit and other hedged replica checks before eval. If miss due to shard mismatch, we mark `dedupe_best_effort=true`. Telemetry: `rerank.dedupe_hits`, `rerank.dedupe_missed`.

Alex: OTOH, ops prefers simplicity: bill everything. It maps to raw resource consumption; no cross-replica coordination. Which do we pick?

Priya: We can compromise: default = dedupe billing + an opt-in param for tenants who want raw billing (no dedupe). Add request header `X-Redwood-Billing-Mode: dedupe|raw`. Default `dedupe`. Documented in API.

Chen: We should also add `billing_mode` as part of the audit logs returned in a response header so customers can reconcile (e.g., `X-Redwood-Billed-As: dedupe`).

Alex: Console UX request for @frontend: show a per-tenant timeseries with three series: requested_count, billed_count, dedupe_credit (requested - billed). Also a %metric: dedupe_rate = billed/ requested.

frontend-bot: noted — will add mockups. Quick Q: how do we label hedged cost vs fallback cost? Customers want per-model visibility.

Priya: Metric plan: break down by model role: `rerank.count_primary_eval`, `rerank.count_fallback_eval`, `rerank.count_deduped`. Cost attribution: attribute billed evals to the model that actually performed the eval. If dedup prevented work, attribute credit to the later model (i.e., show as negative cost on fallback).

Chen: Edge-case: if primary evaluated candidate A and fallback wins but we deduped fallback, how do we show that in quality analysis? Need to record which model produced the answer and which model was charged. We'll include `response_provenance` in trace: model_ids and `charged_eval_counts` in telemetry.

Alex: Also add alerting: if dedupe_rate drops below threshold (eg <75%) for a tenant, notify ops/product; maybe hedging config is misaligned.

Priya: For quota semantics: quotas should count requested candidates for quota enforcement (so a tenant can't bypass quota by relying on dedupe). Billing uses billed evals. So two separate gauges: quota_counter += requested_topk, billing_counter += billed_evals.

Chen: That separation avoids quota games. Good call. We'll need to add `quota_requested_candidates` metric.

Alex: Security/devex note: headers must be optional and validated. If tenant passes `X-Redwood-Billing-Mode: raw`, we need to log consent for billing differences and require tenant-level permission. Else someone could try to force raw billing to game reports.

Priya: Canaries: internal tenants should get `billing_mode=dedupe` default. For experiments, allow ops to flip to `raw` for a subset. We'll add a feature flag per-tenant.

Chen: Implementation details: if we rely on shard-local cache for dedupe, document best-effort semantics: `dedupe_strict=false` by default if cross-rack. Add telemetry label `dedupe_scope: local|global|best_effort`.

Alex: For the API, propose response headers: `X-Redwood-Requested-Count`, `X-Redwood-Billed-Count`, `X-Redwood-Billing-Mode`, `X-Redwood-Dedupe-Scope`. Add these to SDK wrappers too.

Priya: Example snippet to propose in API docs:

```http
POST /v1/rerank
Authorization: Bearer <token>
X-Redwood-Billing-Mode: dedupe
{ "candidates": 200, "model_role": "primary,fallback" }

# Response headers
# X-Redwood-Requested-Count: 200
# X-Redwood-Billed-Count: 47
# X-Redwood-Billing-Mode: dedupe
# X-Redwood-Dedupe-Scope: local
```

Chen: Telemetry doc notes I'll add: summary.metrics = ["rerank.requested_count", "rerank.billed_count", "rerank.count_primary_eval", "rerank.count_fallback_eval", "rerank.count_deduped", "rerank.dedupe_rate", "rerank.dedupe_scope"] and traces should include `request_nonce`, `candidate_ids_sample` for privacy-safe debugging.

Alex: Action items:
- Chen: write server RFC for dedupe cache, scope semantics, and header parsing (assign)
- Priya: write API docs + billing spec + quota separation notes (assign)
- frontend-bot: create dashboard mockups + tooltips copy

Chen: I'll draft RFC today. Need a follow-up to decide eviction TTL (I'm thinking 500ms-2s depending on p99 latency).

Priya: I'll draft docs and coordinate with billing ops on how we invoice dedupe credits.

Alex: Cool. Let's reconvene after PRs land. Thanks everyone :)
